'''Rutan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

A [[Rutanian]] tradition was to go hunting most [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Standard week/Legends|week]], and after the hunts, the Rutanians would have a huge meat feast.

==History==
Throughout their history, the people of Rutan had often been engaged in conflict with their species' offshoot race, the [[Senali (species)|Senali]]. [[Senali]] ultimately won, but the conflict was so devastating that a peace agreement was made: the firstborn children of both worlds' rulers would be exchanged at age seven. When the exchangees turned 16, they would return home, to prevent an attack from the corresponding planet.

The two worlds were almost thrown into war once when Rutan's [[King/Legends|King]] [[Frane]]'s firstborn son, [[Leed]], chose to stay on Senali instead of returning to his birthplace on Rutan. King Frane, convinced his son was being brainwashed, threatened to declare war on [[Meenon]], leader of Senali. Instead, he called upon two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to come and return his son to him. The two Jedi eventually found a way to avoid another battle, and Leed's younger brother [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]] turned out to have a wish to rule, despite his father's ignorance. He became King after Frane.

[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] raids on the trade route were stopped by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].

The planet was [[Battle of Rutan|attacked]] by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaders in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], over a year prior to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], Rutan and Senali were politically divided by the [[Peace Brigade]]. Several months after this, the Senali were wiped out by the Yuuzhan Vong, and half of the population of Rutan was enslaved.<ref name="Remnant" />
